review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient database error classification and test coverage to prevent false-positive error tracking and support workflow recovery.
review.reason: The chunk adds the use of an `is_transient_db_error` check and its corresponding test, establishing a mechanism to distinguish transient database errors from reportable ones. P1.F1.H2 demonstrates the implementation of this check, while P1.F2.H2 adds the test coverage. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and error handling.
